text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard saffron-lite-2.7b into model-catalog tonight 22:00 PT. Objective: add model, pin as `saffron-lite-2.7b:v1-pin`, run small canary on staging, then promote to quiet slot.

deploy-bot: Scheduled catalog update at 2026-03-18T22:00:00-07:00 (PT)

Leo: I'm on infra watch for the window. Which SRE runbook should I follow? :eyes: 

Maya: Use `catalog-onboard-runbook.md` -> step 3 smoke checks. Nora (devex) — can you update quickstart snippets if smoke passes?

Nora: Yep, will prep docs and a short PR. ETA 1h.

Sylvia: PR for model config submitted: https://git.internal/r/redwood/models/pulls/412. Needs a quick review for quant config.

AJ: Looking now. Quick note: set `kv_cache=false` for lite variant in config to avoid memory spikes. I'll drop a suggested diff.

AJ: Suggested diff:
```
model:
  name: saffron-lite-2.7b
  revision: v1-pin
  quant: int4
  kv_cache: false
```

Maya: Good catch. Smoke checklist (to run on staging):
1. curl check with short prompt
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"saffron-lite-2.7b:v1-pin","prompt":"hello"}'
```
2. 99th p50 latency < 700ms
3. token cost vs baseline within 1.2x
4. basic safety eval pass on sample set

Leo: I'll tail infra logs and set an alert rule for memory + OOM. If anything > 85% GPU mem, we'll cut the canary.

Sylvia: I've added rollback label to the PR. Rollback plan: revert to `saffron-2.7b:v0.9` and mark pin deprecated. Script: `scripts/revert-catalog.sh saffron-lite-2.7b`

Maya: Thanks. Final ask — DevEx, please add a short note in console: 'lite variant has lower KV cache; expect faster cold starts.' Nora?

Nora: On it. Will post PR and ping here when docs + console blurb live.

Leo: all set on infra side. I'll be available from 21:45 PT onward. :thumbsup: 

Maya: Great — proceeding on schedule. Ping here when smoke passes. If no major flags, promote at +30m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: catalog update starting in 30 minutes.

AJ: Review done, LGTM. I'll merge the quant config after Nora confirms docs.

Nora: Docs PR merged. :tada: 

Maya: Smoke passed on staging (samples look clean, latency ok). Moving to promote in 15.

Leo: Observability green. No memory issues.

Maya: Promote complete. Closing thread — thanks everyone.
